name: Catamaran
long_description: CatX is a Bermuda regulated digital marketplace for insurance risk. With more than $500m of opportunities listed, it gives hedge funds and other sophisticated investors a direct way to access, analyse and transact insurance risk. Insurance risk is an uncorrelated alternative asset class with a broad range of return profiles. CatX's Catamaran platform helps institutional investors, insurers and risk managers quantify the impact of a risk and decide whether to hedge it or invest in it.
